items.title: Atlas for Government: The Only FedRAMP® Class D Certified Cross-Cloud Operational Database
items.summary: Federal, state, and local agencies are under mounting pressure to modernize legacy systems, adopt AI, and protect sensitive data, all at the same time. Many of the databases that can currently handle an agency's most sensitive, high-impact workloads are native to a single cloud and run nowhere else, leaving agencies with a limited set of authorized options and little room to change course when missions, mandates, or threats shift.
